activities.title: Checkpoint #8

This badge earner understands an overview of UNIX System Services, the role of z/OS as a server in the open systems environment, & how open standards are implemented in a z/OS system by z/OS UNIX. They can identify basic terms used in z/OS UNIX, define components of z/OS UNIX, explain major functions provided in z/OS UNIX, discuss opportunities for applications in a z/OS UNIX environment, identify z/OS base elements & optional features that make up z/OS UNIX, & use the 3 interactive interfaces.This quiz consists of 20 questions and requires a passing score of 16 correct answers. You are granted 2 attempts to pass the quiz, and will then need to wait 5 days before trying again. There are no limits on your total number of attempts.
Here are some resources for you to continue learning after completing this course: Recommended courses Resources Thank you for using IBM TechXchange Training!
